metadata.question: Was the soil in Washington more moist on November 22, 2021 than November 15, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Need soil moisture data. I'll use SMAP (Soil Moisture Active Passive) data which provides soil moisture measurements. SMAP has daily global soil moisture data at ~36km resolution. 2. Masking strategy: SMAP data typically has quality flags. I'll use the 'soil_moisture_am' band and apply quality filtering using the 'retrieval_qual_flag' band. 3. Logic: Compare soil moisture values between Nov 15, 2021 and Nov 22, 2021 for Washington state. Need to handle cases where data might be missing or invalid. import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
washington = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/States') \
    .filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'Washington')) \
    .geometry()

date1_start = '2021-11-15'
date1_end = '2021-11-15'
date2_start = '2021-11-22'
date2_end = '2021-11-22'

# 2. Data Acquisition - SMAP Soil Moisture
def get_smap_data(start_date, end_date):
    col = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/SMAP/SPL4SMGP/007') \
        .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
        .filterBounds(washington)
    return col

col1 = get_smap_data(date1_start, date1_end)
col2 = get_smap_data(date2_start, date2_end)

# Check if collections have data
if col1.size().getInfo() == 0 or col2.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print(f"Nov 15 Images: {col1.size().getInfo()}")
    print(f"Nov 22 Images: {col2.size().getInfo()}")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # Get first image from each collection
    img1 = col1.first()
    img2 = col2.first()
    
    # Apply quality filtering - keep only good quality retrievals
    img1_clean = img1.updateMask(img1.select('retrieval_qual_flag').eq(0))
    img2_clean = img2.updateMask(img2.select('retrieval_qual_flag').eq(0))
    
    # Calculate soil moisture statistics
    sm1_stats = img1_clean.select('sm_surface').reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs=True),
        geometry=washington,
        scale=36000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).getInfo()
    
    sm2_stats = img2_clean.select('sm_surface').reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs=True),
        geometry=washington,
        scale=36000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).getInfo()
    
    sm1_mean = sm1_stats.get('sm_surface_mean')
    sm1_count = sm1_stats.get('sm_surface_count')
    sm2_mean = sm2_stats.get('sm_surface_mean')
    sm2_count = sm2_stats.get('sm_surface_count')
    
    print(f"Nov 15 SM: {sm1_mean:.4f}, Pixels: {int(sm1_count)}")
    print(f"Nov 22 SM: {sm2_mean:.4f}, Pixels: {int(sm2_count)}")
    
    # Validation checks
    if sm1_mean is None or sm2_mean is None or sm1_count == 0 or sm2_count == 0:
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif not (0 <= sm1_mean <= 0.6) or not (0 <= sm2_mean <= 0.6):  # Valid SM range
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif sm2_mean > sm1_mean:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
